name: io.github.useinvio/nfse-mcp
title: NFS-e Nacional
description: Validate, emit, query and cancel Brazil's NFS-e Nacional (SEFIN) service invoices.

environmentVariables.name: NFSE_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the ICP-Brasil A1 certificate (.pfx). Omit to run only the tools that need no certificate.

environmentVariables.name: NFSE_AMBIENTE
environmentVariables.description: SEFIN environment. 'producao' issues legally valid invoices.

environmentVariables.name: NFSE_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable prepare/confirm tools that emit and cancel invoices.

environmentVariables.name: NFSE_MCP_MOCK
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to use an in-process mock SEFIN and a test certificate (no real calls).
